title: Text completions gained a tier label
summary:
A quiet week of making text usage easier to understand and the Pollinations ecosystem easier to explore.

Text completions now include `user_tier`, set to the authenticated tier or `anonymous`. Text event tracking records it too, so usage can be broken down by tier.

Sequa AI's codebase-knowledge MCP URL was added to the README, website news, and MCP guidance. The Claude workflow now permits `mcp_sequa_search_web`, and the separate automated Claude PR-review workflow was removed.

The catalog added projects including websim-pollinations-ai and Visiora. The website gained a projects anchor and listed NavyAI and Nebius as supporters.
